cases.sentence: И тотчас пропел ___, и тогда Петр вспомнил слова Иисуса
cases.translation: And immediately the rooster crowed, and then Peter remembered the words of Jesus.
cases.explain: Петух is the subject of пропел (crowed) — nominative.

cases.sentence: Арестовавшие Иисуса привели его к первосвященнику Каиафе, у которого уже собрались учители ___ и старейшины.
cases.translation: Those who arrested Jesus led him to the high priest Caiaphas, where the teachers of the law and the elders had gathered.
cases.explain: “Teachers of the law” is a possessive genitive → закона.

cases.sentence: Затем Иуда Искариот, один из двенадцати, пошел к ___ с предложением.
cases.translation: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests with a proposal.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to, toward) always takes the dative → первосвященникам.

cases.sentence: Тут подошли люди и, схватив ___, взяли его под стражу.
cases.translation: Then people came up and, having seized Jesus, took him into custody.
cases.explain: Схватив (having seized) takes a direct object; Иисус is animate, so the accusative matches the genitive: Иисуса.

cases.sentence: Что я, разбойник, что вы пришли с ___ и кольями, чтобы арестовать меня?
cases.translation: Am I a robber, that you came with swords and clubs to arrest me?
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → мечами.

cases.sentence: Иисус находился в Вифании, в ___ Симона Прокоженного.
cases.translation: Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper.
cases.explain: The preposition в showing location takes the prepositional → доме.

reading.ru: Они решили хитростью схватить Иисуса и убить.
reading.question: How did the religious leaders plan to arrest Jesus?
options: By waiting for Jesus to surrender
reading.explain: They decided to arrest Jesus by trickery and kill him.

reading.ru: И когда он возлежал за столом, к нему подошла женщина с алебастровым кувшином, в котором было очень дорогое ароматическое масло, и возлила это масло ему на голову.
reading.question: What did the woman do at the table in Bethany?
options: She poured expensive perfumed oil on his head
She washed his feet with water
She gave him bread and wine
She anointed his hands with myrrh
reading.correct: She poured expensive perfumed oil on his head
reading.explain: A woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume and poured it on Jesus' head.

reading.ru: Те отсчитали ему тридцать серебряных монет.
reading.question: How much did the chief priests pay Judas to betray Jesus?
options: Nothing, he did it for free
reading.explain: They counted out thirty silver coins for Judas.

reading.ru: Ученики сделали все, как им велел Иисус, и приготовили пасхальный ужин.
reading.question: What did the disciples do as Jesus instructed?
reading.explain: The disciples did as Jesus told them and prepared the Passover.

reading.ru: «Говорю вам истину, один из вас предаст Меня».
reading.question: What did Jesus announce during supper?
options: One of the disciples would betray him
He would soon be crowned king
reading.correct: One of the disciples would betray him
reading.explain: Jesus said, “I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me.”

reading.question: What did Jesus say about the bread he broke?
reading.explain: Jesus gave the bread to the disciples saying, “Take and eat, this is my body.”

reading.ru: «Пейте из нее все, это моя кровь завета, проливаемая за многих людей для прощения грехов».
reading.question: What did Jesus say the cup represented?
options: His blood of the covenant for the forgiveness of sins
reading.correct: His blood of the covenant for the forgiveness of sins
reading.explain: Jesus said the cup was his blood of the covenant, poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

reading.ru: «Говорю тебе истину», — сказал ему Иисус, — «в эту ночь, прежде чем пропоет петух, ты трижды отречешься от меня».
reading.question: What did Jesus predict Peter would do?
options: Deny Jesus three times before the rooster crowed
reading.correct: Deny Jesus three times before the rooster crowed
reading.explain: Jesus told Peter that before the rooster crowed he would deny him three times.

reading.ru: «Отец мой, если возможно, то пусть минует меня эта чаша, но пусть будет все не как я хочу, а как ты хочешь».
reading.question: What did Jesus pray in Gethsemane?
options: That the cup of suffering would pass, yet God's will be done
That his disciples would stay awake
reading.correct: That the cup of suffering would pass, yet God's will be done
reading.explain: Jesus prayed that the cup might pass from him, yet not his will but God's be done.

reading.question: What did Jesus say about the disciples' ability to stay awake and pray?
options: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak
They were too excited to sleep
They had forgotten how to pray
reading.correct: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak
reading.explain: Jesus said the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.

reading.ru: Предатель так условился с ними, «Хватайте того, кого я поцелую».
reading.question: What sign did Judas arrange to identify Jesus?
reading.explain: Judas told them to seize the one he kissed.

reading.ru: Тогда один из тех, кто был с Иисусом, вытащил меч, ударил слугу первосвященника и отсек ему ухо.
reading.question: What violent act happened during Jesus' arrest?
options: A disciple cut off the high priest's servant's ear
Jesus was struck by a soldier
Judas was attacked by the crowd
A guard drew a sword on Peter
reading.correct: A disciple cut off the high priest's servant's ear
reading.explain: One of those with Jesus drew a sword and cut off the ear of the high priest's servant.

reading.ru: «Все, кто берется за меч, от меча и погибнут».
reading.question: What did Jesus say about those who use the sword?
options: They will die by the sword
reading.correct: They will die by the sword
reading.explain: Jesus said all who take up the sword will die by the sword.

reading.ru: Первосвященники и весь высший совет искали ложных показаний против Иисуса, чтобы приговорить его к смерти, но они ничего не могли найти, хотя и пришло много лжесвидетелей.
reading.question: What problem did the council face at Jesus' trial?
options: They could not find false testimony against him
They disagreed about the death penalty
reading.correct: They could not find false testimony against him
reading.explain: They sought false testimony to condemn Jesus but could not find any, though many false witnesses came.

reading.ru: «Ты сам так сказал», — ответил Иисус. «Но говорю вам, что отныне вы увидите Сына Человеческого сидящим по правую руку от Всемогущего и идущим на облаках небесных».
reading.question: How did Jesus respond when asked if he was the Christ, the Son of God?
options: He affirmed it and spoke of the Son of Man at God's right hand
reading.correct: He affirmed it and spoke of the Son of Man at God's right hand
reading.explain: Jesus said, “You have said it,” and spoke of seeing the Son of Man at the right hand of the Almighty.

reading.ru: «Ты тоже был с Иисусом Галилеянином», — сказала она. Но Петр отрицал перед всеми.
reading.question: How did Peter respond when a servant girl said he had been with Jesus?
options: He denied it in front of everyone
reading.correct: He denied it in front of everyone
reading.explain: Peter denied before them all that he had been with Jesus.

reading.ru: И, выйдя наружу, он горько заплакал.
reading.question: What did Peter do after the rooster crowed and he remembered Jesus' words?
options: He went out and wept bitterly
He confessed to the high priest
reading.correct: He went out and wept bitterly
reading.explain: Peter went outside and wept bitterly after remembering Jesus' prediction.
